items.markdown:
![Define Your North Star Metric: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-af334aca6fb4:4)
A **North Star metric** is `the single key measurement that captures the core value a product delivers to its customers`.[[1]](https://amplitude.com/blog/product-north-star-metric)[[2]](https://productled.com/blog/identify-your-north-star-metric)

It serves as a leading indicator of long-term business success and revenue, aligning cross-functional teams toward a single focal point for growth.[[1]](https://mixpanel.com/blog/north-star-metric/)[[2]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pawel-huryn_the-north-star-metric-is-a-powerful-simple-activity-7285677502784557057-Lp3F)[[3]](https://amplitude.com/blog/good-bad-north-star-metric)[[4]](https://growwithward.com/north-star-metric)

### Key Characteristics of a Good North Star Metric

- **Measures value, not effort:** It tracks the actual value experienced by the user (e.g., songs listened to) rather than company output (e.g., features shipped).[[1]](https://www.metabase.com/glossary/north-star-metric)
- **Acts as a leading indicator:** It moves ahead of financial revenue, signaling future business health rather than lagging past performance.[[1]](https://amplitude.com/blog/product-north-star-metric)[[2]](https://www.metabase.com/glossary/north-star-metric)
- **Influencable:** Teams must be able to directly or indirectly impact the metric through their day-to-day work.[[1]](https://posthog.com/founders/north-star-metrics)[[2]](https://www.metabase.com/glossary/north-star-metric)
- **Understandable and actionable:** It must be simple enough for everyone in the organization to understand and rally behind.[[1]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pawel-huryn_the-north-star-metric-is-a-powerful-simple-activity-7285677502784557057-Lp3F)[[2]](https://productled.com/blog/identify-your-north-star-metric)

### Famous Examples

- **Airbnb:** Number of nights booked
- **Spotify:** Time spent listening
- **Zoom:** Hosted meetings per week
- **Miro:** Number of collaborative boards[[1]](https://growwithward.com/north-star-metric)[[2]](https://amplitude.com/blog/good-bad-north-star-metric)[[3]](https://productled.com/blog/identify-your-north-star-metric)[[4]](https://future.com/north-star-metrics/)

If you'd like, tell me:

- What **type of product or business** you are working on
- Your **primary business model** (B2B, consumer subscription, marketplace, etc.)

I can help brainstorm potential North Star metrics for your specific project.
